required_hypotheses: Fix an integer $n\ge1$. For successive points $x,x^+\in\mathbb R^n$ and vectors $g,g^+\in\mathbb R^n$, define the **step vector** $s:=x^+-x$ and the **gradient-difference vector** $y:=g^+-g$. item_dependency_edges.status: published supplier body and relevant proof/definition inspected
required_hypotheses: A real matrix $B\in\mathbb R^{n\times n}$ is **symmetric positive definite (SPD)** when $B=B^T$ and $z^TBz>0$ for every nonzero $z\in\mathbb R^n$. For an SPD matrix $B$, write $H=B^{-1}$ for its inverse; $I$ denotes the identity matrix of [[def-matrix-product-and-identity-matrix]]. If $s\ne0$ and $s^Ty>0$, set $\rho:=(s^Ty)^{-1}$. The **BFGS Hessian update** and its inverse form are $$ B^+:=B-\frac{Bss^TB}{s^TBs}+\frac{yy^T}{s^Ty}, \qquad H^+:=(I-\rho sy^T)H(I-\rho ys^T)+\rho ss^T. $$ The denominators are positive under the stated hypotheses.

required_hypotheses: Call [[alg-bracketing-zoom-strong-wolfe-search]] with $(f,x_k,p_k,c_1,c_2,E,Z)$. If it returns a failure status, return that status and $x_k$. Otherwise take its positive strong Wolfe step $\alpha_k$, and define $$ s_k:=\alpha_kp_k,\qquad y_k:=\nabla f(x_k+s_k)-g_k. $$ In undamped mode set $\bar y_k:=y_k$. In Powell mode put $c_k:=s_k^TB_ks_k$ and use the damping rule of [[def-bfgs-curvature-pair-and-update-formulas]] to form $\bar y_k$. If $s_k^T\bar y_k\le0$, skip the matrix update and return curvature-rejected. Otherwise update both matrices by $$ B_{k+1}=B_k-\frac{B_ks_ks_k^TB_k}{s_k^TB_ks_k} +\frac{\bar y_k\bar y_k^T}{s_k^T\bar y_k}, \qquad H_{k+1}=(I-\rho_ks_k\bar y_k^T)H_k(I-\rho_k\bar y_ks_k^T)+\rho_ks_ks_k^T, \quad \rho_k=(s_k^T\bar y_k)^{-1}. $$ Return update-failure if any required scalar or matrix operation is undefined; otherwise continue until stationarity or budget exhaustion. The output is the last point and one of stationary, a line-search status, factorization/solve failure, curvature-rejected, update-failure, or iteration-budget-exhausted.
